Kanye West (aka YE) for @zeit .. let me explain: I first met him in New York in 2022 with a friend and had a lovely interaction. He gave us his assistant’s number so we could stay in touch. I didn’t know much about him back then. But when I later watched Coodie Simmons’ documentary Jeen-Yuhs, I fell in love with the young Kanye: He was ambitious to the point of absurdity, but somehow still deeply vulnerable. He was funny, ambitious, insecure and impossible not to root for.

I wanted to talk to him again. But we all know: things took a very dark turn… his antisemitism, praise of Hitler and Holocaust denial made me abandon the idea of ever meeting him again.

But when he started making his way back into the spotlight this year, I wanted to understand: Who is he now? Who are we supposed to take seriously - the man who went off the rails, or the one asking for forgiveness? Or both? And what, if anything, is left of the old Kanye? 

So I went looking for him. Talked to Coodie Simmons, Rick Rubin, André Troutman, Che Pope, just to name a few. 

Followed him to Tirana and Madrid. Spent time in his hotels, at soundchecks and afterparties. How close can you get to someone who has spent years making himself unreachable?

— 

Thank you so much to everyone who said I shouldn’t do this story - I think you were right. 

BUT an even bigger thank you to everyone who supported me along the way, especially the goats @marlene.knobloch & @laura_hertreiter @zeit and @mrs.bockmist @annadreussi @hermesbaby___ and everyone who had an open ear for my stories and ideas along the way.
